page_title: BHA 1-1 BUR | Brighton v Burnley 09/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+8' Brighton can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

90+8' The ball is crossed into the box and Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the roof of the net, but James Trafford gets a glove on it to thwart him. Brighton get a corner.
90+5' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Brighton comes to nothing.
90+4' Billy Gilmour (Brighton) meets a cross inside the box, but his header is blocked by an opposing player. Brighton will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
90+4' Pascal Gross (Brighton) swings in a cross from the corner, but James Trafford reads it well and gathers the ball.
90+2' Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails a few inches over the bar!
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.
88' James Trafford leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Pascal Gross (Brighton).

87' Pascal Gross (Brighton) takes a mid-range free kick and the effort crashes into the defensive wall. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Brighton will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
86' Simon Hooper shows a yellow card to Nathan Redmond (Burnley) for his blatant foul.
85' Roberto De Zerbi prepares a substitution. Lewis Dunk is replaced by Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton).
82' Substitution. Hjalmar Ekdal (Burnley) in, Zeki Amdouni out.
81' Brighton fail to score from a corner as James Trafford (Burnley) leaps to collect the ball.
81' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. The ball goes out of play. Brighton are awarded a corner kick.
79' The manager makes a subsitution with Connor Roberts (Burnley) coming on for Aaron Ramsey.
78' Here is a change. Wilson Odobert is going off and Vincent Kompany gives the last tactical orders to Mike Tresor Ndayishimiye (Burnley).
78' It will be a substitution. Nathan Redmond (Burnley) is ready to enter the pitch as Jay Rodriguez walks off.
77' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Simon Adingra (Brighton) does well to meet a cross inside the box and produces a stunning header that goes inside the left post.
75' Surely that's handball by one of the Burnley players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
75' Pascal Gross (Brighton) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

74' Simon Adingra (Brighton) picks up a cross inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the right side of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by James Trafford, who pulls off a stunning save! The ball goes out for a corner. Brighton can continue in their attacking effort.
72' Wilson Odobert (Burnley) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Simon Hooper had an easy-decision to make.
72' Aaron Ramsey (Burnley) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
70' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Pascal Gross (Brighton), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
70' Joao Pedro (Brighton) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. Brighton have been awarded a corner kick.
66' This is a yellow card! Charlie Taylor (Burnley) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
64' Evan Ferguson (Brighton) latches onto a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but sends his header miles wide of the right post.
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Igor (Brighton) replaces Carlos Baleba.
59' Roberto De Zerbi decides to make a substitution. James Milner will be replaced by Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton).
58' Substitution. Johann Berg Gudmundsson walks off the pitch and Aaron Ramsey (Burnley) comes on as a substitute.
57' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
51' Evan Ferguson (Brighton) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Simon Hooper blows for a foul.

50' Jay Rodriguez (Burnley) is first to latch onto the rebound inside the penalty area. He drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but it is denied by the goalkeeper who pulls off a superb save.

50' What an amazing save by Bart Verbruggen! Wilson Odobert (Burnley) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot low towards the middle of the target, but fails.
48' Billy Gilmour (Brighton) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
46' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Billy Gilmour comes on the pitch for Mahmoud Dahoud (Brighton).
46' Here comes a substitution. Adam Lallana is given a rest as he is replaced by Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' 0 - 1 Goal! Wilson Odobert (Burnley) neatly controls a decent pass from Jay Rodriguez. He looks up and smashes an unstoppable drive into the top left corner from the edge of the box. 0:1.
43' Pascal Gross (Brighton) works the corner short.

42' Adam Lallana (Brighton) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Brighton.
37' Mahmoud Dahoud (Brighton) fires the ball towards goal from just outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar after coming very close to hitting the roof of the net.
35' Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) rises above the defence inside the box to power a fine header, but the goalkeeper is lucky as the ball flies narrowly wide of the right post.
34' James Milner (Brighton) receives a pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, James Trafford makes a great save to stop his effort.
33' Simon Adingra (Brighton) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
30' Simon Adingra (Brighton) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
29' James Milner (Brighton) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

28' Pascal Gross (Brighton) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, James Trafford makes a great save to stop his effort. The ball goes out of play and Brighton have been awarded a corner kick.
26' Simon Hooper has a clear sight and sees a foul from Adam Lallana (Brighton).
24' A pass from James Milner (Brighton) is intercepted by James Trafford and the move breaks down.
19' Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) latches on to a pass on the edge of the box, but he can't get any power into the shot and fails to trouble Bart Verbruggen.
17' Jay Rodriguez (Burnley) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
17' Vitinho (Burnley) serves up a nice cross, but Bart Verbruggen punches the ball away.
15' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Brighton, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
14' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Dara O'Shea (Burnley) was quite harsh and Simon Hooper didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
13' A pass from Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) is intercepted by Bart Verbruggen and the move breaks down.
10' Close! Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.
8' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Wilson Odobert (Burnley) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
7' Brighton are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
3' The resulting corner from Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
3' Wilson Odobert (Burnley) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. Burnley win a corner.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Brighton will take the kick-off.
Simon Hooper was nominated as the referee for this game.
